ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory initial and periodic screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, authorised signatories and counterparties against the EU consolidated asset-freeze/smart-sanctions list, the UN Security Council consolidated list, the OFAC SDN List, the Central Bank of Cyprus directives and Cyprus FIU list of high-risk third countries. Automated screening with full-name exact match and fuzzy-match review, 100% non-resolvable-match escalation, enhanced due diligence and 12-month cooling-off scrutiny for any PEP status or prior adverse-media finding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR) – Cyprus Business and e-Companies portal (e-filing at https://efiling.drcor.mcit.gov.cy)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A Cyprus private limited company may use the Greek or Latin alphabet. If Greek is transliterated into Latin characters, the spelling must be presented consistently and must correspond to a clear phonetic or standard form; the corporate suffix must be Limited/Ltd or the Greek equivalent Λτδ. The full name must not be misleading, must not duplicate an existing name or trademark conflict, and must render unambiguously in both scripts in all statutory/registry filings.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may, within 15 calendar days of the refusal, file a written reconsideration request with the DRCOR through the e-portal, stating the legal and factual grounds and supplying trademark/prior-name evidence. If reconsideration is refused, the applicant may file an administrative annulment application before the District Court/administrative court under Article 146 of the Cyprus Constitution; alternatively, a new name variant may be re-presented. Approval, if granted, applies only to the exact variant, is not assignable, and cannot be extended beyond 180 days except by filing a fresh name-approval application before expiration and paying the statutory re-filing fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for the company-law registered-office obligation: a licensed service-provider address can be designated as the registered office of a non-licensed, medium-risk revenue-financing SPV. However, the registered office alone does not create Cyprus tax residence or economic substance; board decisions and management must be physically taken in Cyprus if Cyprus tax residence is intended. Any bank or agent will normally require a physical correspondence address and proof of substance before opening payment-rail accounts or issuing a tax-residence certificate.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 15% annual probability of an unannounced inspection for an unlicensed SPV of this type, rising to 40% if the company claims tax residence, transacts more than USD 5 million per year, or files a zero-employee VAT/revenue financing profile. The Cyprus Tax Department and the Registrar conduct risk-based, physical on-site checks when revenue/asset ratios or bank flows appear disproportionate to declared substance.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Cyprus Companies Law, Cap. 113, as amended; Sections 17-25 (incorporation and registration), Section 8 (certificate of incorporation), Section 18 (memorandum and articles), Section 20 (registered office), and Sections 30-31 (officers and company secretary).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver, Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Nicosia, Cyprus.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form HE1 - Application for Registration of a Company, together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and a statutory declaration of compliance.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a private limited liability company under Cap. 113; the Company shall adopt an initial issued capital of EUR 1,000 divided into 1,000 ordinary shares of EUR 1.00 each, fully paid in cash. No escrow account requirement applies to non-regulated private companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) The proposed allotment and issuance of 1,000 Ordinary Shares of EUR 1.00 each, nominal value, at par for cash to the founding subscribers identified in the subscribers' statement is authorized and approved; the directors shall issue share certificates expeditiously. (2) The registered office of the Company shall be established at [Registered Address], Nicosia, Cyprus, and the Company Secretary is directed to file all statutory notices with the Registrar of Companies. (3) [Name] is appointed as first Director, and [Name] is appointed as first Company Secretary, each consenting to act until replaced under the Articles. (4) Any officer is authorized to execute all ancillary constitutional documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cyprus Trade Registry online portal, Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search proposed name against the company and business names register using the Trade Registry portal; submit a name reservation application reflecting the intended ISIC 6499 royalty financing and revenue-based financing objects; pay the statutory name reservation fee and retain the search receipt and reserved name certificate.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and two alternative names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected due to similarity, file a written objection with the Registrar within 14 days or promptly submit an alternative reserved name; administrative re-examination is available at no additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public / Advocate authorized under the Advocates Law, Cap. 2
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the English-language Memorandum and Articles of Association using the statutory model forms, ensuring an objects clause that covers royalty financing, revenue-based financing, loan origination, and ancillary licensing activities; each founding subscriber executes the documents before a notary; prepare the statutory declaration of compliance under Section 8 of Cap. 113.
required_dossiers: Drafted Memorandum and Articles of Association
KYC/AML identity evidence for each subscriber
Power of attorney if any subscriber is a corporate entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar requires amendment of objects or internal governance clauses, execute a supplementary memorandum deed under Section 20 of Cap. 113 and re-file the corrected instrument.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver - Ariadne Electronic Company Registration System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form HE1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, reserved name certificate, statutory declaration of compliance, and consents of the first officers; pay the registration fee through the Ariadne online portal; the Registrar examines legal conformity and issues a unique company registration number.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act from first director and company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, submit corrected documents through the online resubmission mechanism within 14 working days; written legal submissions to the Registrar may be used to clarify non-standard objects or governance provisions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Tax Identification Number Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies and the Cyprus Tax Department (TIC/VAT Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under Section 8 of Cap. 113; concurrently apply for the Tax Identification Code (TIC) using Form TFE 002; if the taxable turnover threshold applies, submit the VAT registration application; the Cypriot Registrar shall arrange publication of the incorporation notice in the official State Gazette.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If TIC issuance is delayed due to identification mismatches, provide notarized certified copies and state the company's QNE status; accelerated processing may be requested from the District Tax Office for urgent commercial engagements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Statutory Officer Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Section; Local Municipality for premises use
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify physical presence of the registered office in Cyprus; file Form HE29 for registered office notification and Form HE31 for particulars of directors and company secretary; maintain the statutory books and register of beneficial owners at the registered office in compliance with Cap. 113 and the UBO Law.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or ownership title of the office premises
Form HE31 - Particulars of Directors and Secretary
Consent forms and identity proof for officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar serves a non-compliance notice, cure within 14 days by filing the missing forms and paying the prescribed late fee; an officer may also submit a certificate of correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; Registrar of Companies for return filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt a written shareholders resolution to implement the share allotment; issue share certificates to subscribers; file a return of allotment with the Registrar of Companies on Form HE18; update the shareholders' register and beneficial ownership register accordingly.
required_dossiers: Share ledgers and specimen share certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Form HE18 is filed late, pay the applicable late penalty and submit a supporting affidavit; the underlying allotment remains valid once the statutory register is properly updated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Local Municipality - Business Licensing Section; Department of Labour Inspection for workplace safety and health
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business Operating Permit - Commercial Office Use (Certificate of Suitability of Premises)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no formal EIA required; the activity is office-based and falls outside the mandatory EIA categories under the Environmental Impact Assessment Law N. 127(I)/2018
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emissions; sanitary effluent to municipal sewer in compliance with the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC); all waste handling by licensed contractors under the Waste Law N. 185(I)/2011.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Cyprus Fire Service under the Fire Services Law N. 3/1975; structural load inspection and electrical installation certificate by a licensed civil/electrical engineer; workplace occupational health and safety clearance under the Safety and Health at Work Law N. 89(I)/1996.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Cyprus Tax Department (Τμήμα Φορολογίας/Inland Revenue), Ministry of Finance; official portal: https://www.taxdepartment.mof.gov.cy (e-filing and VAT submissions through the TAXISnet Cyprus electronic system).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity (branch or company) must first register with the Registrar of Companies and then apply to the District Tax Office for the statutory Tax Identification Code (TIC). The application incorporates the company’s registered office proof, memorandum/articles of association, ownership declarations, and identification of beneficial owners. For VAT purposes, a separate VAT registration application (Form VAT-101) is submitted through the Tax Department’s e-portal; a taxable person whose annual taxable turnover exceeds or is expected to exceed €15,600 must register within 30 days of that fact, while non-resident entities with no Cyprus establishment but engaged in taxable transactions must register for VAT through a fiscal representative. The obtained TIC serves as the TRN (Tax Registration Number) for all national tax and VAT filings, and must be quoted in all returns, invoices, and customs declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Cyprus does not operate a US-style check-the-box election or elective hybrid-mismatch regime. Available statutory elections include: (i) group relief loss election for companies with at least 75% common shareholding; (ii) notional interest deduction election on new equity contributed after 2015; (iii) Intellectual Property Box election under section 9D of the Income Tax Law for qualifying intangible assets (2.5% effective tax rate on qualifying profits); (iv) election to apply the small-business VAT cash accounting or flat-rate scheme; (v) transfer pricing documentation choices under OECD-aligned Chapter V. The Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive hybrid mismatch rules are mandatory and cannot be elected.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax / ΦΠΑ) under the Cyprus Value Added Tax Law No. 94(I)/2000, aligned with the EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €15,600 annual taxable turnover of supplies of goods and services; separate thresholds apply to intra-EU acquisitions and distance selling (including €10,000 cross-border B2C digital services annual threshold).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Cyprus has no real-time fiscal clearance requirement, no mandatory digital stamping, no continuous transaction controls, and no general B2B e-invoicing mandate. VAT returns, VIES recapitulative statements, and Intrastat declarations are filed electronically via TAXISnet/Facilis. Electronic invoicing is lawful and subject to authenticity, integrity, and readability requirements under VAT Law; the Tax Department may exercise post-audit access to electronic invoicing data, but no SAF-T filing obligation is currently in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT) applies to: (1) intra-Community supplies of goods to a customer established in another EU Member State where the supplier obtains the customer’s valid VAT identification number, reports the supply in a recapitulative statement, and holds documentary evidence of transport/dispatch; (2) direct exports of goods outside the European Union evidenced by customs export documentation; (3) services supplied to persons established outside Cyprus where the place of supply is outside Cyprus under the B2B main rule, including royalty and financing services rendered to offshore recipients, cessio of intangibles, and revenue-based financing arrangements; and (4) certain international transport and ancillary services. Input VAT directly attributable to zero-rated transactions is fully deductible.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic Single Administrative Document / Export Summary Declaration)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill / CMR consignment note evidencing physical removal from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT credit confirmation evidencing foreign exchange repatriation
Commercial invoice standing in the name of the exporting entity
Packing list and proof of export value
Intra-Community Sales List (VIES) with customer VAT number and proof of delivery for EU supplies
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Cyprus Customs and the Tax Department conduct targeted audits of export zero-rating, applying a documentary evidence standard demanding transport, payment, and customer registration proof. If export zero-rating is found to be unsupported or fraudulent, the VAT at 19% is re-assessed from the date of supply with statutory interest (2% per month or part thereof), together with administrative fines up to 100% of the unpaid tax and potential criminal sanctions for tax evasion, including imprisonment up to three years. False invoices backing sham exports trigger denial of input VAT credit, joint and several liability among participants, and publication of serious offenses. Export records must be retained for at least six years to survive clawback risk.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Cyprus (Kentriki Trapeza tis Kyprou), operating under the Central Bank of Cyprus Law L.138(I)/2002 as the national competent authority within the Eurosystem; monetary policy and euro issuance authority reside with the European Central Bank (ECB).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible on both current and capital account; Cyprus maintains no exchange controls on EU/EEA transactions since EU accession (2004), and capital-account restrictions with third countries were fully dismantled following the orderly exit from the 2013 crisis-era measures. Capital movements between Cyprus and non-EU jurisdictions are unrestricted but subject to statistical notification and Central Bank of Cyprus monitoring under the Capital Movements Law L.71(I)/2004 and applicable ECB balance-of-payments reporting regulations. Dividend and interest remittances by a Cyprus Ltd to non-resident shareholders are free of exchange restrictions and domestic withholding taxes, providing effective profit-repatriation parity with EU resident flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender or mandatory conversion obligations apply in Cyprus; export/service proceeds may be retained in any currency and held offshore or locally. For balance-of-payments statistical compliance, the Central Bank of Cyprus requires the electronic reporting of each resident-to-non-resident transaction equal to or exceeding EUR 12,500, filed monthly through the CBC BOP e-reporting portal on or before the 15th business day of the following month; bank-account crediting of export receipts is conditional on the client's submission of the transaction purpose code at initiation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Cyprus Public Company Ltd
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account: Multi-currency EUR/USD/GBP demand and disbursement account with segregated internal ledger lines for investor capital vs portfolio disbursements
Capital Escrow Account: Segregated hold account receiving equity injections, released against board-approved draw-down notices to underlying revenue-based financing contracts
Operational Account: Corporate clearing hub for intra-EU SEPA flows and trade-services documentation (LC/bank guarantees)
Operational Account: Overlay treasury account for FX spot/forward settlement and overnight liquidity parking
Operational / Escrow hybrid: Designated for high-volume digital-merchant collections where enhanced due-diligence file sharing is pre-agreed

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility. Cyprus-licensed e-money and payment institutions registered under the Payment Services Law L.240(I)/2018 (PSD2-implementing) offer segregated collection IBANs, SEPA Direct Debit origination, and automated reconciliation, and are viable as secondary collection-only rails for the high-frequency direct-debit target flow. However, they are not viable as the primary treasury counterparty for this structure because: (a) they cannot extend credit or settle the reverse transfer without a sponsor-bank settlement account at an EU credit institution; (b) onboarded accounts face hard EUR transaction ceilings or monthly velocity caps; and (c) sponsor-bank ACH/SEPA return risk is born by the originator. Offshore EMIs (UK, Lithuania, Ireland) may passport into Cyprus under EU/EEA rights but are subject to additional correspondent-bank due diligence and are accepted only for decoupled collection wallets, never for escrow of investor capital.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and every 25%+ ultimate beneficial owner must complete a recorded interview. Cypriot banks mandate at least one physical in-person appearance (at the branch or before an ICPAC-licensed accountant / Cyprus Bar Association lawyer acting as certifier) to execute the account-opening board resolution and specimens; remote opening is legally possible where the introducer holds a CySEC or ICPAC AML licence and the client maintains a prior 12-month relationship, but approval rates for first-time non-resident directors remain low and documentary notarisation/certification by a Cypriot TCSP is effectively mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue-based financing to high-volume digital commerce and SaaS merchants classified as unregulated lending or a quasi-banking money-laundering typology
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: External legal opinion under ISIC 6499 confirming the vehicle is a non-deposit-taking, own-account revenue-share financing fund expressly outside the Banking Law and Crowdfunding Law perimeters; signed Financing Program Memorandum; audited schema of each portfolio contract (funding amount, agreed revenue-share percentage, cap, settlement mechanics); authority map demonstrating no client-money holding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concentrated non-EU inbound funding routed from low-tax or disproportionate-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group organogram and economic-substance file of the Cyprus entity (premises, employees, directors' residence, board minutes); investor capital-formation pack: certified passport, proof of address, 2-year bank reference from an OECD-regulated bank, notarised UBO certificate, source-of-wealth statement with documentary evidence on all inbound amounts; declared commercial rationale for the Cyprus-domiciled financing fund.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Instant-transaction request to disburse through non-bank rails to merchants connected to high-risk sectors (gaming, crypto-adjacent, affiliate marketing)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-approved merchant whitelist mapped to ISIC codes with negative screening against EU/UN/OFAC sanctions and adverse media; payment-file level purpose-code consistency; clawback/refund operating procedure; quarterly independent AML audit report from an ACAMS-certified compliance consultant demonstrating CDD/EDD refreshes and sanctions re-screening on each contractual counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or key director domiciled in a FATF/EC high-risk or non-cooperative third country
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax residence certificate from competent authority; Cyprus substance attestation (residential lease, tax filings, social-insurance records, Cyprus driver's licence); unbroken 3-year primary bank relationship letter; enhanced UBO verification via dual independent documentary sources and a corroborative professional reference from a regulated lawyer/accountant.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Investor capital arrives via SWIFT MT103 to the segregated EUR escrow account at the Cypriot credit institution. Country paryment instructions: beneficial owner BIC, IBAN, and Central Bank of Cyprus balance-of-payments purpose codes per injection type — 5501/5510 for equity contribution, 5120 for subordinated shareholder loan; each transfer must be countersigned by a board capital-call resolution, the signed facility or subscription agreement, and the investor UBO file, with settlement occurring through TARGET2 on a T+0 basis. Any third-country remittance exceeding EUR 12,500 is automatically captured in the CBC BOP monthly return for which the bank relies on the client's purpose-code declaration at remittance initiation. Non-bank e-money collection of investor funds is strictly precluded.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Disbursements to portfolio digital brands settle within SEPA via SDD Core/B2B for EUR payments against signed draw-down notices, and via SWIFT MT103 (gpi tracked) for non-EUR, non-EEA or high-value payments; commercial letters of credit are permissible only for collateralised inventory-backed contracts, which are outside the standard revenue-share model, therefore not activated. Every outbound transaction equal to or above EUR 12,500 requires a CBC BOP transaction code, the disbursement contract reference, and a matching police-cleared audit trail retained for 5 years; the bank applies forced-positive sanctions screening to every beneficiary IBAN/BIC before release.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla OTC deliverable EUR/USD and EUR/GBP outright forwards (non-margined, master agreement under an ISDA 2002 or local CPA-form master) with Bank of Cyprus or Hellenic Bank treasury desks
Short-dated FX swaps on euro cross pairs to bridge mismatches between USD-denominated revenue-share receipts and EUR disbursement obligations
Cross-currency basis swaps linking USD/GBP revenue-share collections to EUR redemption commitments for medium-tenor balance-sheet matching

Deep out-of-the-money deliverable EUR calls to cap adverse convertibility against a stepped USD/BGBP revenue curve; NDFs are neither customary nor necessary as the euro remains fully convertible, and any NDF proposal would fail the bank's product-suitability and substance tests

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form HE32) with financial statements (audited or, if audit-exempt, unaudited)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DROCOR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the annual general meeting; AGM must be held at least once every 15 months (first AGM within 18 months of incorporation).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts statutory default fines; persistent non-filing after formal notices leads to administrative strike-off and loss of limited liability protection.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DROCOR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: First instalment of EUR 200 due by 30 June; final instalment of EUR 150 due by 31 December of each calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid levy incurs an automatic penalty of 5% (minimum EUR 50) plus a EUR 50 administrative fee; two consecutive years of non-payment enable administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit unless the company qualifies as small on two consecutive balance sheet dates: balance-sheet total not exceeding EUR 350,000; net turnover not exceeding EUR 700,000; average employees not exceeding 10. Dormant companies remain audited unless an exemption is formally approved.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the European Union for larger companies and financial holding entities; Cyprus GAAP (based on IFRS for SMEs) permitted for eligible small companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No standalone annual UBO return; the UBO register must be kept at the registered office and updated with DROCOR within 14 days of any change. At the annual return filing, the company confirms the member register underlying UBO data is accurate and current.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of General Meetings and Board Meetings

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 12.5% flat corporate income tax rate (no municipal surcharge or local income tax for companies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP Box regime: 80% exemption of qualifying IP profits producing a 2.5% effective rate (modified nexus, OECD-aligned); Notional Interest Deduction (NID) on new equity injected after 1 January 2015 at the annually gazetted ministerial rate (e.g., 3.65% for 2021, 3.11% for 2022); foreign dividend and foreign permanent establishment (PE) profit exemption subject to anti-abuse conditions; group loss relief; 50% notional deduction on certain accommodation/entertainment costs; no WHT on outbound dividends and generally no WHT on outbound interest; gains on disposal of shares (including participations in the revenue-based financing fund structure) are exempt from Cyprus income tax except where the shares derive value from Cyprus real estate.
